title: Lacked enough instruction
text:
This would be great for those who are experienced in painting with acrylics. I'm a total newbie so I need a bit more direction. I need to know what brush they are using, I need to learn more about brush strokes, etc.

My paintings came out so bad because I simply do not know what I'm doing with the brush strokes. I'm getting way to many hard lines and I can't visually see exactly how he's doing the brush strokes and half way through the project I was using the wrong brush. Towards the end someone in chat (these are recorded live I suppose) asked what brush number and I had it all wrong. I'm not mad, I got a good laugh at my efforts.

Youtube beginner videos that I've followed in the past gave me such beautiful completed art that I started hanging them up all over my home. These will not make it to the walls, but will keep them hidden away for future giggles.

Once I get these basics mastered I WILL be back! Lol
